sb256.title: PNW International Student Services - Indiana Senate Bill 256 information

test_policy.notes: PNW says it is test-optional for undergraduate admission; SAT/ACT scores are encouraged because they help with math placement. The international page also lists the SAT as one accepted way to show English proficiency but prints no minimum score.

requirements.notes: International Undergraduate Student Application on the PNW portal; $25 non-refundable fee for students with no previous college. Proof of secondary-school graduation (unofficial copies accepted to start; no WES/ECE evaluation required); official documents on matriculation. No minimum GPA is published on the pages read. Personal statement is optional. Indiana law SB 256 (from Aug. 15, 2026) adds a research-security review before admission for citizens of listed 'foreign adversary' countries (China incl. Hong Kong and Macau, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Venezuela, others) who are not U.S. citizens, green-card holders, or asylees/refugees (see the PNW SB 256 page).

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: The page prints 'Fall Semester: June 1' without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. All required materials must be received by this date. Spring semester deadline is Oct. 15.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants must submit one of: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, PTE, SAT, British O-Level English (grade A or B), or at least 12 transferable credits from a U.S. accredited institution including a course equivalent to ENGL 10400. No list of exempt countries is published on the page read.

english.notes: Exams taken on or after 2026-01-21; the page states the 1-6 scale.

aid.notes: First-year and transfer applicants are automatically considered for the PNW Academic Achievement Scholarship (based on high school GPA, no application, renewable up to 4 years with a 3.0 GPA and 24 credits per year). The page publishes no award amounts and does not say whether international students are eligible, so no international merit policy is recorded. The old PNW English Language Program (intensive English) pages now redirect to the international admissions page, and no conditional-admission pathway is published for international undergraduates.

toefl.note: The international page says PNW's school code is 001638 for all standardized tests including TOEFL; the 4-digit form of the same code is 1638.
